name: flowcore
description: Connects coding agents to the Flowcore event platform and teaches them to operate it: the resource hierarchy, IAM policies that actually match, virtual and managed Data Pathways, and building apps with the @flowcore/pathways SDK.

interface.shortDescription: Operate Flowcore data cores, IAM and Data Pathways from your agent.
interface.longDescription: Adds the Flowcore MCP server and four skills: the platform model and safety rules, IAM with the only valid policy format, Data Pathway operations (virtual by default), and building event-driven apps with the @flowcore/pathways SDK.
defaultPrompt: List my Flowcore tenants and summarize what is in each
